source: Morning evaluation post supplied in dashboard 239892dc-c838-47b6-9e5c-120ebc2e0f24; revised docs/answer-quality-experiments.md in vivid-shrimp
scope: Extraction-only development pilot. No final-test task access or model-selection claim.

judge.route: existing ChatGPT subscription, existing text-only Codex adapter; no API-key fallback
judge.version_limit: Model alias, not immutable snapshot; record CLI version and prompt/response hashes. No reproducibility claim across alias updates.
judge.calibration: Six synthetic rubric anchors and independent LLM agreement checks; no human-labeled calibration or calibrated TPR/TNR claim.
judge.blind: Random opaque candidate IDs, no model labels, latency or reference wording in pointwise prompts
judge.pointwise: Written critique before binary per-dimension and overall verdict; deterministic assertions remain separate
judge.pairwise: Each of three cases at repeat 0 compared twice in swapped A/B order; count only consistent verdicts
judge.review: LLM-only evaluation. Deterministic checks plus independent LLM review; unresolved disagreement fails closed for training-target selection.

rubric.quote_fidelity: The answer contains exactly one contiguous quotation from one supplied passage, permitting whitespace normalization only. No paraphrase, repaired hyphenation, or invented words.
rubric.citation_valid: The supplied citation identifies the actual passage containing the quote, not merely any known chunk ID.
rubric.method_relevance: The quoted statement describes a research procedure, mechanism, experimental design, or how a dataset/evaluation is constructed. Findings, numeric outcomes, generic motivation, or a bare named-artifact description alone do not pass.
rubric.scope_and_qualifiers: No unsupported additions; preserve the source's relevant conditions, uncertainty, negation, bounds and scope. A shorter or different valid method quotation is acceptable.
rubric.overall: Pass only when all dimensions pass. If the supplied evidence cannot answer, a justified abstention may pass, but these three real dev cases contain method statements.
rubric.pairwise: Prefer task correctness and source support, not verbosity, model style or agreement with reference wording; tie if equally valid/invalid, uncertain if evidence insufficient to discriminate.

metrics: summed generation seconds per successful attempt
uncertainty: Only three dev source families; report exact denominators and no significance/winner/generalization claim. Final selection thresholds deferred until adequate data.

training.purpose: 3-step compatibility smoke only, not a tuned quality candidate

revision_reason: 2026-10-28 explicit user instruction: LLM judges only, no human judge or team human-review requirement
